messages:
ana: heads-up — seeing a spike in fncall validation errors for async toolhooks, lots of partial JSON blobs from adapters.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary rollout 6/20 at 09:12 — schema-validator v2 -> 10% traffic

ben: repro? logs?

ana: paste logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T09:14:22Z adapter=paymenthook fnid=xx123 status=200 body="{\"status\":\"ok\",\"tx\":null"
2026-03-20T09:14:22Z validator error=EOF while parsing object
```

chia: sounds like partial writes from adapter timeouts; are we retrying or classifying as validation_failure?

derek: FYI this is inflating billable token usage because adapter returned partial tokens and we still charged full; need route-level accounting.

eva: UX: Console shows "fncall rejects" count but not cause. We need validation_reason in the per-route dashboard and sample payload links.

ben: Also routing policy quirk: permissive route sends to fallback model which changes token attribution. maybe we should route to no-charge degen path on parse failures.

ana: current header used: `X-Route-Mode: permissive` — maybe add `X-Validate-Action: softfail|reject`?

frank: proposal: when validator sees truncated JSON -> emit telemetry event `fncall.validation_failure` with tags: reason:truncated, adapter:, route:, suggested_action:soft_reject, charge:false. And add a boolean `reported_as_billable` we set to false if adapter closed early.

chia: for rollout: canary should sample 1% strictly reject (hard reject) and 9% softfail (return partial + fallback) so we can measure user impact.

derek: need to coordinate billing — billing team wants a bounded rule: if validator error and body length < X => non-billable. But careful with edgecases.

eva: Console mock: show a "Validation breakdown" panel w/ pie of softfail/hardreject/parse_error and quick link to sample payloads (redact).

frank: I'll open PR for telemetry schema and a new dashboard tile. Anyone want to co-review?

ben: I'll help with the billing rule spec; ping me when PR is up.

ana: tagging @sre since adapter timeouts might be infra.

sre-oncall: looking

sre-oncall: found an 5xx burst on adapter cluster at ~09:13, increasing tail latency. investigating :mag:

deploy-bot: rollback scheduled at 09:40 for canary if errors > 2.5% (current 4.3%)

ana: thanks — can we add a softsample flag in console so support can toggle sampling for user repros?

eva: yes — add quick toggle "Include validation payloads" w/ PII redaction.

frank: PR link: https://git.redwood.dev/p/eng-platform/telemetry/+/42 — draft

ben: :thumbsup: will review

ana: leaving an action item: frank add telemetry event, eva add console tile, ben draft billing rule, chia adjust canary sampling. I'll follow up tomorrow with status.
